quotes.text: We have reason to believe one of our people is giving intel to the enemy. Hit an enemy communication center and get us a name.

quotes.text: “The Bynar ship went missing on stardate 58934.9.” “Okay, so your intel is legit, but this still feels like a trick.” “No. I'm a changed computer. Just look at me. Do you see the blue light?” “The light is reassuring.”
